    Conference

    PSA Conference — Lukas Stelzl Keynote Talk

    less than 1 minute read

    Published: August 10, 2026

    Lukas Stelzl gave a talk as keynote speaker about the exciting ongoing work in the lab at the Peptide Self-Assembly (PSA) Conference 2026 in Mainz, Germany (10–12 August 2026). The conference brought together researchers working on self-assembling peptide systems, and Lukas presented our lab’s latest work using molecular simulations to understand peptide and protein self-assembly. Read more

    GRS: Decoding Disorder by the Numbers — Quantitative and Integrative Approaches to IDPs Across Scales

    less than 1 minute read

    Published: June 20, 2026

    Emanuele Zippo attended the Gordon Research Seminar “Decoding Disorder by the Numbers: Quantitative and Integrative Approaches to IDPs Across Scales” in Les Diablerets, Switzerland (20–21 June 2026). The meeting brought together researchers using quantitative and computational approaches to study intrinsically disordered proteins and was a great opportunity to discuss ongoing research with the IDP community.     Excursion

    A Fungal Adventure: Mushroom Picking in Frankfurt city Forest

    1 minute read

    Published: September 15, 2023

    Nestled in the heart of Germany, the Frankfurt city Forest is a haven for nature enthusiasts and those seeking a unique outdoor experience. One of the most exciting and rewarding activities the forest offers is mushroom picking. The lush woodlands are home to a diverse array of mushroom species, making it an ideal destination for both seasoned foragers and beginners eager to explore the world of fungi. Read more

    Outreach

    Girls & Boys Day 2026

    less than 1 minute read

    Published: April 23, 2026

    Our lab once again contributed to Girls & Boys Day. It was great to demonstrate to young minds how molecular dynamics simulations can help us understand cellular processes, using examples of amino acids, peptides, and moving proteins in a box. It was an incredible opportunity to inspire them and show a glimpse of the exciting opportunities in theoretical biophysics. Read more
